items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-21
items.q: there's another group of fellows I played with this was back at town along the negro section was Buzz Hartley bass ... Nick LaRocca corner I played

ctx.x: them did you ever know a song about Barnacle Bill the Sailor no sir I didn't

know Barnacle Bill the Sailor at that time I never knew Barnacle Bill the Sailor if it existed I had never known it but there were many tunes like people would sing then came around the hand organ and he'd grind out three tunes for a nickel the older boys and girls and the young kids would try to follow the bigger ones and all the people sat on the on the corners they didn't go riding on the mobiles and carriages the streets were made of mud couple of streets with cobblestones and the electric lights thing was…
oh what estimates did they play I didn't get that oh you didn't get it well I'll tell you
